title: Retimed complex word (#495) on cross-copy hosting with #493's bit word: conditional κ 1.452948511251494e-3 (stacked on #494)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"rosswaycaster"} -->
_Requested by **Ross** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01MQm3YGAz7NNfofWzQLZCPP?thread=cmsg_01MQm3YGAz7NNfofWzQLZCPP8e9dNkgbw9s5L3Xy3dJ44Q)_

## Change and mathematical scope

Before: the strongest open comparable witness was PR #494, conditional κ = 358867191156973/2.5·10¹⁷ =
0.001435468764627892, bound by its complex supplier (PR #448's cross-copy hosting of PR #433's word, b =
718766148669433/5·10¹⁷).

After: conditional **κ = 726474255625747/500000000000000000 = 0.001452948511251494**, complex-bound, **1.22 % above PR #494**, with the same bit
supplier (PR #493's R489 word, unchanged) and a new complex supplier.

The complex word is PR #495's retimed R560 word (Ali Romman), which combines PR #449's shared-donor kernel (DreamingOfClouds) with PR #458's paid two-sided residual adapters (chafreaky). It is rebuilt from its frozen `FULL-WORD.json.gz` by PR #495's own word-level scripts, vendored byte for byte (`SOURCE.json`). It is placed in PR #433's nine-stage template (m = 73, eight replicas), the template PR #494 prices. Every helper residual is hosted on idle data coordinates, so no banks are needed:

- the 79 entering (width-8) residuals per stage go whole onto pattern copies, with PR #495's route chart and adapters, each alone on its family in its call, as in PR #495;
- the 481 width-9 residuals per stage go on PR #448's cross-copy tape, as in PR #494.

Pattern copies and tape copies are different families. The complex lower bound rises from b = 1.437532·10⁻³ (PR #494) to b = 1455062642351477/10¹⁸ = 1.455063·10⁻³. The bit side is unchanged (c = 1.565442·10⁻³). `PROOF.md` gives the construction and the compatibility argument.

How: `research/r489-retimed-cross-copy-complex/verify.py` runs PR #494's own `verify.py` unchanged, then this package's steps, then the exact
assembly (`code/assemble_complex.py`, PR #494's `assemble_489.py` with the complex word directory as an argument): two
rational moment engines, six bootstrap levels, all 47 strict outer inequalities, next grid point and zero-η, zero-β,
unit-β controls rejected. The result is compared with `EXPECTED.json` and must exceed PR #494's κ.

Stacked on PR #494 (head `419907c71246c050f1c3fd2a504469b74bf7798e`); only the commits after that head are new. Every assumption of
PR #494 stays an assumption. PR #448's cross-copy slot is disputed in the discussions on PR #451 and PR #485, and this package uses it only where PR #494 does. This package adds PR #495's assumptions for its word: PR #449's expanded scalar interface, PR #458's paid two-sided residual adapters, and PR #495's pending mutable-target, idle-hosting and Gaussian-adapter interfaces. It also adds one new composition point: PR #495's whole entering-residual hosting is used in the nine-stage m = 73 template, on families kept separate from PR #448's tape. The audit checks that separation in every call; `PROOF.md` gives the argument. A finite certificate is not a formal proof of the asymptotic theorem, no Lean
proof is claimed, and κ is an exponent saving, not a measured runtime speedup. Prepared with Anthropic Claude via
Claude Code for Ross (rosswaycaster); full credits are in `research/r489-retimed-cross-copy-complex/NOTICE.md`.

Credits: **Ali Romman** (PR #495: the retimed word and the vendored word scripts), **chafreaky** (PR #458: paid two-sided residual adapters), **DreamingOfClouds** (PR #449: shared-donor kernel; PR #484: entering-helper invoice form), **higherbeing** (PR #494: the composition this stacks on; PR #448: cross-copy hosting), **eumemic** (PR #493: the R489 bit word), **DaysSky** (PR #442: idle-data hosting and its verifier), **icekylinx** (PR #433: the nine-stage template and split centres), and every author in the source-pinned notices.

## Validation

- Component certification passed: `verify.py --parent-output` on a verified, complete PR #494 output (receipt status, manifest and every step-log digest checked) ran all five new steps and printed `PASS_COMPONENTS_WITH_VERIFIED_PR494_REUSE` with κ = 726474255625747/500000000000000000 (Python 3.13.16). The receipt and step logs are in `research/r489-retimed-cross-copy-complex-validation/`.
- **The full clean rerun (PR #494 from scratch, then this package) is in progress**, along with `make verify` and `make gen4-bank-verify` on this branch. The results will be added as a commit to this branch.
